2608.27021.title: FaulT-Bench: Towards Benchmarking Network Troubleshooting LLM Agents under Unreliable User Tickets
2608.27021.paper_summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly proposed for network fault diagnosis, but existing benchmarks evaluate them only on accurate tickets and always assume a fault is present, conditions rarely met in practice. We present FaulT-Bench, a benchmark of 200 troubleshooting scenarios across eight network topologies, five reimplemented from public practitioner labs, spanning genuine faults, false fault reports, incorrect device attribution, and incorrect root-cause claims. To isolate how ticket wording affects diagnosis, we further rewrite 72 false-premise tickets into five reporter personas that vary reporter confidence and verifiable detail one factor at a time, holding the network state fixed. Our automated harness deploys each scenario in Kathará, lets agents interact through the NIKA tool interface, and scores free-text diagnoses with an LLM judge across outcome, fix, and reasoning quality. Evaluating SADE, ReAct, and Claude Code, we find all three are near-saturated on accurate tickets and robust to misdirection, yet degrade sharply when the network is healthy and the ticket is wrong, probing until a benign condition can be promoted to a root cause rather than concluding nothing is wrong. Persona rewrites show that how a ticket is written matters more than what it claims: a confidently wrong report is handled about as well as an accurate one, while a vague, underspecified report degrades performance sharply. The three agents also fail differently, from constant over-diagnosis to unanswered runs, at very different cost. These results position FaulT-Bench as a benchmark for developing agentic systems that can reason reliably over the noisy, unreliable tickets of real-world network troubleshooting.
2608.27021.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的代理越來越多地被提議用於網絡故障診斷，但現有的基準僅在準確的工單上評估它們，並且總是假設存在故障，這在實踐中很少滿足。我們提出了 FaulT-Bench，一個涵蓋八種網絡拓撲的 200 個故障排除場景的基準，其中五個是從公共實踐實驗室重新實現的，涉及真實故障、錯誤故障報告、錯誤設備歸屬和錯誤根本原因聲明。為了隔離工單措辭如何影響診斷，我們進一步將 72 個錯誤前提的工單重寫為五種報告者角色，逐一變化報告者的信心和可驗證的細節，保持網絡狀態不變。我們的自動化工具在 Kathará 中部署每個場景，讓代理通過 NIKA 工具界面互動，並根據結果、修復和推理質量使用 LLM 評判自由文本診斷。評估 SADE、ReAct 和 Claude Code，我們發現這三者在準確工單上接近飽和，對誤導具有穩健性，但在網絡健康且工單錯誤時急劇下降，探查直到無害的條件可以被提升為根本原因，而不是得出沒有問題的結論。角色重寫顯示，工單的寫作方式比其聲明的內容更為重要：一個自信的錯誤報告的處理效果與準確報告相當，而模糊、不具體的報告則顯著降低性能。這三個代理的失敗方式也不同，從持續的過度診斷到未回答的運行，成本差異很大。這些結果使 FaulT-Bench 成為開發能夠在現實世界網絡故障排除的嘈雜、不可靠工單上可靠推理的代理系統的基準。
